Players Committee card image of [[The First Order Was Just The Beginning (Errata)]] (PC-E1 image; no errata mark), printing: “Deploy on table. Your [Episode VII] troopers are forfeit +1. Once per turn, if [Episode VII] Emperor on table, may ▼ Kijimi or place any three cards out of play from your Lost Pile to deploy a non-unique [Episode VII] trooper from Lost Pile. [Immune to Alter.]” Uploaded unchanged.
